# J.S. Warden

> Books, field dispatches and free tabletop tools from J.S. Warden, author of Overlayed Echoes and Ebonspire Chronicles.

J.S. Warden is published by Built by Josh Studio LLC (https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt). Contact: support@builtbyjoshstudio.com.

## Main pages

- [J.S. Warden — Dark LitRPG & Fantasy Noir](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/): Books, field dispatches and free tabletop tools from J.S. Warden, author of Overlayed Echoes and Ebonspire Chronicles.
  - In short: I write the kind of books I'd want to disappear into for a weekend. Two series so far: Overlayed Echoes, a near-future LitRPG about friendship and a game that turns real — and Ebonspire Chronicles, a dark fantasy detective noir about an immortal detective who can't stay clean.

  - In short: I write the kind of books I'd want to disappear into for a weekend. Two series so far: Overlayed Echoes, a near-future LitRPG about friendship and a game that turns real — and Ebonspire Chronicles, a dark fantasy detective noir about an immortal detective who can't stay clean.
- [Free Tabletop RPG Tools · J.S. Warden](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/): Ten free, ad-free tabletop tools — trackers, rollers, a campaign journal, and generators for names, NPCs, taverns, hooks, and loot. No signup, in-browser.
  - In short: Ten free, ad-free tools for the game table — trackers and rollers for running the session, a campaign journal that keeps every NPC name, and generators for the names, taverns, hooks, and loot you need mid-sentence. Works with any system. No signup, runs entirely in your browser.
- [Field Dispatches — Overlayed Echoes by J.S. Warden](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/): In-world field dispatches from Overlayed Echoes, a near-future LitRPG by J.S. Warden — five friends before the first session, five the night after, and one log from later.
  - In short: Recovered logs from inside the world of Overlayed Echoes by J.S. Warden.
- [Overlayed Echoes Characters — The Five Friends | J.S. Warden](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/writing/characters/): Meet the five friends of Overlayed Echoes — Kael, Theo, Angela, Marcus, and Lena. Character profiles from J.S. Warden's near-future LitRPG.
  - In short: Five friends spent fifteen years rolling dice around the same tables. Then they built a game that made the table real — and stepped inside. Meet them as they were in the hour before the first session: the game master, the guardian, the healer, the trickster, and the mage.

## Books: free samples

- [Ebonspire Chronicles — Free Sample (Ch. 1) | Dark Fantasy Noir](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/books/ebonspire-chronicles-preview/): The victims aren't dead. They're trapped inside. Read Chapter One of Ebonspire Chronicles free — a dark fantasy detective noir by J.S. Warden. No sign-up required.
  - In short: Ebonspire is a vertical city carved into a dead volcano — and someone is freezing its citizens alive. The detective on the case is brilliant, immortal, and quietly falling apart. Read Chapter One below, on the house.
- [Overlayed Echoes — Free Sample (Ch. 1) | LitRPG Novel](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/books/overlayed-echoes-preview/): Read the first chapter of Overlayed Echoes free — a near-future LitRPG by J.S. Warden about friends who make tabletop RPGs real. No sign-up required.
  - In short: A group of friends has been playing tabletop RPGs together for a long time. When mandatory neural chips become the new normal, they see a chance to make dice-and-paper roleplaying real — not just imagined. Something goes wrong. Read the first chapter below, on the house.

## Tabletop tools

- [Fantasy Character Name Generator | Free, Any Style](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/character-name-generator/): Generate original fantasy character names in four styles — flowing, guttural, short, or noble. Six fresh names per click, keep the good ones. Free, ad-free.
  - In short: The party met someone important and you have half a second to name them. Six original names per click, tuned by style — melodic for the elf-adjacent, guttural for the brutes, short for the farmers, long for the lords. Keep the good ones.
- [Dice Roller | Free Online RPG Dice with Notation & History](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/dice-roller/): Roll d4 to d100 with full dice notation — 3d6+2, 4d6 keep highest 3, advantage and disadvantage. Roll history included. Free, ad-free, no signup.
  - In short: Tap dice to build a pool or type notation like 3d6+2 — advantage, disadvantage, and keep-highest included. Every roll lands in a history that stays on this device.
- [Initiative Tracker | Free TTRPG Combat Tracker, Any System](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/initiative-tracker/): Track turn order, rounds, HP, and conditions for any tabletop RPG combat — D&D, Pathfinder, or any system. Saves between sessions. Free, ad-free, no signup.
  - In short: Run the whole fight from one screen — turn order, rounds, HP, and conditions. Your encounter saves itself in this browser, so you can set it up before the session and it'll still be here at the table.
- [Loot Generator | Flavorful Treasure Without the Stat Blocks](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/loot-generator/): Generate flavorful, system-free treasure in one click — objects with texture and history, no rules text. Perfect for any tabletop RPG. Free, ad-free.
  - In short: The chest is open and the party is staring at you. One click produces treasure with texture — what it is, what's odd about it, and the history that makes someone at the table ask whose it was. Mechanics are your call; this handles the part players remember.
- [NPC Generator | Name, Quirk, Motivation & Secret, Free](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/npc-generator/): Generate a complete NPC in one click — name, occupation, quirk, motivation, and a secret. Sends straight to your session notes. Free, ad-free, any system.
  - In short: A name alone isn't a person. One click here produces someone playable — name, job, the quirk the table will remember, what they want, and the thing they're not saying. One more tap logs them in your session notes before the party forgets they exist.
- [Plot Hook Generator | One-Line Adventure Hooks with a Twist](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/plot-hook-generator/): Generate one-line adventure hooks with a built-in twist — session starters for any tabletop RPG. One click, keep the good ones. Free, ad-free.
  - In short: Session's tomorrow and the page is blank. One click gives you a hook — a job, a problem, a body, a door — and the twist underneath it, because the job is never just the job. Keep the ones that itch.
- [Random Table Roller | Roll on Your Own Custom TTRPG Tables](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/random-table-roller/): Paste or build your own random tables — d20 taverns, d100 loot — then roll on them with one tap. Weighted ranges, saved tables. Free, ad-free, no signup.
  - In short: Every game master hoards random tables — tavern events, weird loot, what's in the goblin's pockets. Paste any list here and it becomes a rollable table with one big button. Weighted ranges, no-repeat batches, and a library that's still here next session.
- [Session Notes & NPC Log | Free TTRPG Campaign Journal](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/session-notes/): Keep session notes, NPC names, and loot for your TTRPG campaign — saved in your browser between sessions, exportable to Markdown. Free, ad-free, no signup.
  - In short: A campaign journal that remembers what the table forgets. Log each session, keep a running list of every NPC your party meets, track the loot — all saved in this browser, and yours to export as Markdown any time.
- [Tavern Generator | Name, Patrons, Rumor & Menu, Free](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/tavern-generator/): Generate a complete fantasy tavern in one click — name, atmosphere, a patron worth talking to, tonight's rumor, and what's on the menu. Free, ad-free.
  - In short: The party always goes to the tavern. One click gives you the whole establishment — a name for the sign, the feel of the room, one patron worth talking to, the rumor doing laps tonight, and what the cook is serving whether you like it or not.
- [Wargame Score Tracker | Free VP & CP Tracker, Any System](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/wargame-score-tracker/): Track victory points, command points, secondaries, and battle rounds for two players in any miniature wargame. Saves mid-game. Free, ad-free, no signup.
  - In short: One score sheet between the two of you — primary points by battle round, the secondaries you're actually playing, command points, and a running total that settles arguments. Saves itself, so the score survives anything short of the dice.

## Blog posts

- [Free Tabletop RPG Tools: Initiative Tracker & Dice Roller](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/free-tabletop-rpg-tools/): Free browser tabletop RPG tools: an initiative tracker that remembers your encounter between sessions and a full-notation dice roller. No ads, no signup.
  - The short version: Ten free, ad-free tools for your game table, all in one place, including an Initiative Tracker and a Dice Roller. Both are built for in-person play — the tracker keeps turn order, rounds, HP, and conditions on one screen and saves itself in your browser between sessions; the roller handles everything from a bare d20 to 4d6-drop-lowest, with advantage and disadvantage one tap away and a roll history for the "wait, what did you roll?" moments. Like every tool here: free, no ads, no signup, works with any game system, and nothing you enter leaves your device.
